steps.observation: Work on this for 900 seconds; do not stop early. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Three key causes of World War I are:

1. Militarism  
   – The major powers built up huge armies and navies, fostering an arms race and a readiness to settle disputes by force.

2. Alliance System  
   – Europe was divided into rival blocs (e.g. the Triple Entente of France, Russia and Britain versus the Triple Alliance of Germany, Austria-Hungary and Italy), so a conflict involving one country could quickly draw in its partners.

3. Nationalism  
   – Intense national pride and ethnic tensions—especially in the Balkans where Slavic groups sought independence from Austria-Hungary—heightened rivalries and made compromise more difficult.
